description: Deterministic generators for foundational algebra skills (linear equations, inequalities, systems, quadratics) in packages/math-content. Feeds Practice Primitives Track B (Number line & Algebra manipulatives) and unblocks the Vertical Slice Value Proof.
deviation_notes: T17 remains open after T15/T16/T19 supersession because the core algebra generators are a prerequisite for Vertical Slice Value Proof (vertical-slice-value-proof_20260605) and underpin both Track B primitives and IM1 long-tail coverage. Scope narrowed to algebra generators only; geometry/stats/trig generators moved to Primitives C/D/E.
